name: Reading of the Natal Stars (Whispers of the Heavens, Level Three)

system.description:
A diviner who knows a subject's name and date of birth (or date of Embrace, for Cainites) gains access to a wealth of information about that person's core identity and destiny, tracing the position of the stars under which he was born.

The player suffers a bonus difficulty Trait if the character knows only the subject's name or birth date but not both, and three bonus Traits if he knows neither. Each success reveals one piece of core identifying information (Nature, Demeanor, approximate Willpower, Road and rating, notable Disciplines or Abilities, ideally revealed in-character rather than by game terms); five successes grant clues to the subject's ultimate fate, at the Storyteller's discretion. A failed challenge gives the subject a sudden, lingering sense that someone has been watching him — he will recognize the sorcerer instantly if he ever encounters her.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
